description: Cancel a listing only after explicit seller approval. Requires its private management token and latest updated_at. Removes it from public search. Already-cancelled retries succeed. Cancellation cannot be reversed through this tool.

expected_updated_at.description: Latest updated_at from get_sale; prevents overwriting concurrent edits.

management_token.description: Private token returned after verified publication, or the seller’s emailed edit code.

name: cancel_sale
